changelog: Initial release. Read-only health audit for recurring / scheduled AI agent jobs. Detects silent failures, duplicate active jobs, retry loops, over-frequent schedules, stale automations, risky model usage, and context bloat. Evidence-first, manual verification before any change. No auto-fix, no telemetry, no external LLM call.
